body:
Completing each PR840 centered BIT shear separately repeats the target's ADDRESS-layout restoration. For a shared target and unchanged source, this contribution batches dyadic indices into consecutive runs: **r indices in c runs use 2r+c ordinary recursive children instead of 3r**, with no additional full private row. Seed 55 selects `{0,1,2,4,5}`: **15 → 12 children, 90 → 72 affine events, ten XOR scans unchanged**.

**Status: recursive-interface research construction; no new kappa.** The written proof establishes the exact query minimum only in the uniform target-query/source-XOR alphabet with signed dyadic powers, including arbitrary off-support excursions. Concrete controls show why nondyadic queries and fixed-modulus cancellation lie outside that theorem. The coefficient-aware work and storage recurrence pays every native affine event, full child, source scan, layout return, preparation and tape obligation. This is not a selected supplier, a general circuit lower bound or a measured runtime improvement.

Review entrypoint: [research/dyadic-query-runs/README.md](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/research/dyadic-query-runs-seed55/research/dyadic-query-runs/README.md). Only that new directory is added, including the proof, literal certificate, deterministic evidence, source pins, local sprint claim and validation record.

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/dyadic-query-runs/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/dyadic-query-runs/test_package.py
```

Expected: `PASS_DYADIC_QUERY_RUNS cases=63 seed=55 children=15->12 affines=90->72 XOR=10` and `PASS_DYADIC_QUERY_RUNS_PACKAGE relocation=1 regeneration=2 corruptions=8`.

Validation:

- All 63 declared index sets, both complete invoices and exact Laurent endpoints/inverses. A separate bounded shortest-walk census exhausts 15,616 states and 156,672 edges for all 15 smaller index sets; it is distinct from the written unbounded argument.
- Fourteen native lowerings: 84 rational columns, 756 modular columns and 228,956 complete native-address comparisons with all four configurations of two intervening spectator fields. 252 dirty forward and 252 inverse VALUE executions pass.
- Fifteen rejection controls, two positive scope controls, offline relocation, exact regeneration and eight package-corruption controls pass. CPython 3.14.6 and 3.9.6 agree on the full evidence receipt. Retained files match original Git objects.
- Selected-record integrity and all five existing selected-result tests pass. One root `make verify` in an untouched base archive completed six historical groups, then was deliberately stopped during entrance banks after the mandatory `gen4-bank-verify` gate separately failed for missing SymPy. **No full-suite, selected-supplier cold replay, hosted-CI or formal multiplication-proof pass is claimed.**

Exact development base: `47481c89fd30a43f8f882eb4b391e89c29273fd0`. Direct predecessor: **Wentao Li / PR840**, `da2cd0dd2229e08b61b174a8835a2c2bb99d2230`; credit also **Karl Appel / PR521**, **commdata2338 / PR677**, and the original OpenAI tape framework. Their original proofs, notices and licenses are preserved with source pins. The selected PR890 certificate is unchanged and remains complex-bound; this local BIT construction supplies no new exponent.

The refreshed full queue covered 700 open PRs through #947; the immediate pre-submission check reached #950. PR840 covers one pair; this adds batching across an arbitrary finite dyadic index set and a restricted exact optimum. PR934/943/944 use different multi-source dirty-connector contracts. No pinned coordination issue exists, so the claim and result are local. Main advanced to `007664306fff84fbb1c9a1b4053b69f439764034` without changing the selected record. No duplicate of this scoped result was identified.

Prepared by **Ross Richardson (@RossRichardson)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance**, under Apache-2.0. No independent human review or literature-priority claim. All-size compilation, realization, physical frames/owners, whole-row hosting, tape/precision and analytic transfer remain obligations. Nothing is merged and the selected frontier is not edited.
title: Research construction: optimal dyadic-run BIT query batches (no new kappa)
